title: Independent P1–P5 joined qualification and carrier reconciliation
summary:
Independently prove the joined product gates after remediation and reconcile generated
plan carriers without product repair.
why:
Local package checks missed three cross-package regressions, false GREEN and stale
lifecycle views. P6 needs one trustworthy integration boundary.

include:
full root/package validation; isolated DB preflight; Task-owned projection
regeneration; current/historical plan-lint classification; final receipt and P5 closure readiness.
exclude:
product fixes; rewriting journal history; hand-editing state/status; weakening
gates; committing without explicit authority; starting P6.

rules:
Use an independent Sol session. Perform no product write. Confirm the
PostgreSQL target ends in `_test` before PG tests. Run §7 in order. A red product check returns the
exact owning item; it is never labelled pre-existing without reproducing it on the checkpoint
baseline. Regenerate projections only through `plan-views.py`. Never rewrite journal lines. Record
all legacy plan-lint errors and require zero newly introduced diagnostics relative to the sealed
post-remediation checkpoint. If the active Task runtime cannot legally close with historical debt,
return nonterminal `waiting-owner` with the exact incompatibility.
guidance:
The qualification report is a command/result matrix with exit codes, test counts,
baseline SHA, worktree path count and ownership for every failure. No prose-only GREEN.
